name.local: 株式会社旺文社ベンチャーズ

strategy.thesis: Japan's first EdTech-focused fund set up by an educational publisher (Obunsha). Invests in early-stage EdTech and AI companies — cognitive-science learning, educational robots, AI, VR/AR and education AdTech — and supports them with Obunsha's content, platforms and channels.

application.how_to_apply: Contact via official website; corporate venture investing into EdTech/AI startups

summary.en: Corporate venture arm of Tokyo educational publisher Obunsha, billed as Japan's first EdTech-dedicated fund (10億円, 2018). Backs early-stage EdTech and education-AI startups such as Studyplus, WonderFi and Yondemy, leveraging Obunsha's learning content and channels.
summary.local: 東京の教育出版社・旺文社のCVC。国内出版業界初のEdTech特化ファンド（10億円、2018年組成）として、スタディプラスやワンダーファイ、Yondemy等のアーリーステージEdTech・教育AIスタートアップに投資する。

name.local: Gakken Innovation-Tech Fund（学研ホールディングス）

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture program of Gakken Holdings investing in EdTech (education) and CareTech (nursing/medical) startups that have services, technology or customer bases offering business/management synergy with the Gakken group, plus DX-enabling IT services. application.how_to_apply: Corporate venture investing via Gakken Holdings; contact through Gakken corporate channels

summary.en: EdTech/CareTech corporate venture program launched by educational publisher Gakken Holdings in 2021, deploying up to 30億円 through 2025 into startups with education or eldercare technology and synergy with the Gakken group.
summary.local: 教育出版大手・学研ホールディングスが2021年に開始したEdTech／CareTech特化のCVC投資プロジェクト。2025年までに総額30億円規模で、教育・介護領域の技術や顧客基盤を持ち学研グループとシナジーが見込めるスタートアップに投資する。

summary.en: Cited as Japan's first independent education-specialist VC (c.2014). Ran an education seed accelerator and incubation space and backed EdTech startups including SpeakBuddy, Cityviste (acquired by freee) and Arcterus (acquired by Kokuyo). Now dormant; founder Yusuke Kurishima went on to found Protostar and the seed VC HAKOBUNE.
summary.local: 日本初の教育領域特化の独立系VCとされる（2014年頃設立）。教育系シードアクセラレーターやインキュベーションオフィスを運営し、スピークバディ、Cityviste（freeeが買収）、Arcteras（コクヨが買収）等のEdTechに投資した。現在は休眠状態で、共同創業者の栗島祐介はその後プロトスターおよびシードVC「HAKOBUNE」を設立した。

strategy.thesis: Non-profit running 'Edvation Open Lab', a METI-commissioned EdTech incubation/accelerator program (under the 'Learning x Society linkage / EdTech innovation creation support' project). Provides mentoring, seminars, pitch events and overseas-event support to seed/early-stage EdTech innovators and new entrants to education. Also organizes the Edvation x Summit EdTech global conference.

summary.en: Non-profit (est. June 2017, rep. Masahiro Sato) that runs the METI-commissioned 'Edvation Open Lab' EdTech incubation program — mentoring, seminars, pitch events and overseas-event support for seed/early EdTech innovators — and the Edvation x Summit EdTech global conference. Non-equity support rather than a capital provider.
